„
— Topaz (Blue Jay)

Involvement

Act One

Topaz is building a nest in the Sacred Pool near X: 228 Y: 493.

Companion approval

The party can advise Topaz on how to decorate the nest via  Speak with Animals:

  • [DECEPTION] I'd leave it out - it's too dull. (DC 10)
  • [DWARF] [PERSUASION] Leave it out - the metal's bad quality. It'll turn green very quickly. (DC 5)
  • [BARD] Trinkets will rust, friend. A song shines on forever. Give it a try.

Any of the above:  +1  +1  +1

  • [NON-BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Kick at the bird, trying to scare it away. (DC 5)  +1  +1
  • [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION] Away from the coin, or I'll make a headpiece from your feathers. (DC 5 )

If the party convince Topaz to move one of the items or frighten Topaz away, all objects in the nest can be taken freely. Otherwise, taking the items is considered stealing.

Loot

Topaz's nest contains:

  • 1 Gold
  • Magnifying Glass
  • Quill
  • Shiny Key
  • Wheat

Bugs

If any of the items were taken prior to speaking with Topaz, the image of the nest displayed in the cutscene still contains them.
